ValidationRule.description: Retained and Terminated accounts must have something in the description field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( IM_At_Risk_Status__c, "Retained"), ISPICKVAL( IM_At_Risk_Status__c, "Terminated"), ISPICKVAL( IM_At_Risk_Status__c, "Salvaged") ), Len(Retained_Terminated_Description__c) = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Retained Result or Terminated Reason required for Retained and terminated accounts.
